neighbours.label: comfort and indulgence: junk food, couch lounging, keeping warm (couch potatoes, sweet potato fries, sundaes)
fire: On Sundays the whole family turns into couch potatoes in front of the television.
You never know how far a person will go for a plate of sweet potato fries.
She buys a cup of mulled wine at the market just to keep her hands warm.
After the breakup she needed all the double fudge sundaes in the world.
He spent the rainy afternoon under a blanket with a bag of cheese puffs.
Nothing beats curling up by the fire with hot cocoa and marshmallows.
We ordered greasy pizza and binge-watched the whole season on the couch.
The diner is famous for its loaded chili fries and thick chocolate milkshakes.
quiet: On Sundays the whole family goes hiking in the hills behind the town.

After the breakup she needed long runs along the river every morning.
He spent the rainy afternoon repairing the leaking gutter on the garage.
Nothing beats an early start at the desk with a clear plan for the day.
